name: lecture
description: A lecture at a chalkboard: a fitted presenter rendered in Blender in front of a board Remotion draws, all from lecture.json

scripts.board: npx remotion still BoardBg public/board/bg.png && npx remotion still BoardTitle public/board/title.png && npx remotion still BoardShortBg public/board/bg-short.png
scripts.blender: cd ../.. && uv run tools/lecture.py render $INIT_CWD && uv run tools/lecture.py bg $INIT_CWD
scripts.render: npx remotion render src/index.ts Lecture out/lecture.mp4
scripts.render:preview: npx remotion render src/index.ts Lecture out/preview.mp4 --scale=0.5
